# EMN Projects Airconditioning

> F-Gas certified air conditioning, cold room and ducting contractor in Roodepoort, serving all of Gauteng, South Africa. 10+ years experience, all brands installed, free quotes.

## Services
- [Air Conditioning Installation](https://emnprojectsairconditioning.online/services/air-conditioning-installation/): Correct sizing, clean installation and a compliant electrical setup for split, multi-split and cassette air conditioners. We install all brands for homes, offices and shops.
- [Air Conditioning Service & Repairs](https://emnprojectsairconditioning.online/services/air-conditioning-service-repairs/): Routine servicing, fault finding, repairs and preventive maintenance to keep your air conditioners efficient and reliable. Refrigerant work is done by F-Gas certified technicians.
- [Cold Room Installation & Repairs](https://emnprojectsairconditioning.online/services/cold-rooms/): Design, supply, service and install cold rooms and freezer rooms with precise temperature control for restaurants, butcheries, retailers and food producers.
- [Ducting Systems](https://emnprojectsairconditioning.online/services/ducting-systems/): Efficient duct design and installation for balanced airflow and reduced noise in offices, shops, warehouses and restaurants.
